sources.entry: WWDC - The Mac OS unofficial WWDC app. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/insidegui/WWDC)
WWDC - Unofficial WWDC app for macOS.

summary.one_liner: An unofficial macOS app for watching WWDC keynotes, session videos, and transcripts, with bookmarks, notes, and iCloud sync.
summary.what_it_does: The app streams the WWDC Keynote and Platforms State of the Union live and provides videos for all sessions released during WWDC week, plus other video content from Apple's website or Developer app. It has Explore, Schedule, and Videos tabs, with the Schedule tab offering live streams for each day of the current conference. Videos include playback speeds from 0.5x to 2x plus custom speeds, fullscreen and native picture-in-picture, and searchable transcripts in multiple languages that jump to a point in the video. Users can favorite videos, track progress, and create bookmarks with annotations that are included in search. A clip sharing feature shares segments up to 5 minutes long, and share buttons produce universal links that open in the app on a Mac or in the Apple Developer app on iOS.
use_cases: Watch WWDC keynote and session videos on a Mac
Read and search WWDC session transcripts
Take timestamped notes while watching conference videos
Share a short clip from a WWDC session
Sync favorites and watch progress across Macs
Catch up on past WWDC sessions from previous years
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the releases page, or clone the repository.
Run ./bootstrap.sh before opening the project; it asks for your Apple Developer team ID and installs swiftlint via brew if needed.
Build using the WWDC scheme (the one without iCloud in its name).
notable: Unofficial client for Apple's WWDC API and video content, with live streams of the Keynote and Platforms State of the Union
Timestamped bookmarks with annotations that feed into search
Transcripts that are searchable and let you jump to a point in the video
Clip sharing of segments up to 5 minutes
Optional iCloud sync for favorites, bookmarks, and progress
caveats: Builds made from source have CloudKit functionality disabled, so iCloud sync is only in the signed release.
Building requires Xcode 16 or later and an Apple Developer team ID for the bootstrap step.
Running ./cleardata.sh or ./cleardebugdata.sh deletes all preferences, favorites, bookmarks, and progress.
